text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right! A hero's power
isn't meant for themselves!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It's meant for saving someone!
Reach her, my burning passion! To Bakushin O-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: O-Ohhhh, what is this running?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose! I can do this too!
I'll show them I can win!
And then, Bakushin O-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh, uwooooohhhhh!
My body is... on fire!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's right... for someone else's sake,
I'm gonna get stronger and stronger!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus's running had transformed. To that speed, forged through rigorous hard training—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the strong desire to race "for someone's sake" added, her sharpness reached even greater heights.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... Bakushin O-senpai...
Did you have fun?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Did that take your mind off the loneliness a bit?
Though the current me might still not be enough.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
...Biko-san, and Flight-san.
It appears I was...
gravely mistaken about everything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Just having Biko-san join in makes the race
so incredibly energetic!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I want to see both of you run your hearts out tomorrow! And then—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I want to be an overrrr-whelming class president
who can blow even that away! That is my heartfelt wish!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-senpai! In that case...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm certainly not leaving the turf.
Thanks to all of you, I feel rejuvenated.
Down to a three-year-old, even!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I can hardly wait for the day we meet next!
Flight-san, will you run with me again?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yeah! A stage without Bakushin O-chan is just totally unthinkable!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of
umamusume Biko-chan will become after the Classic tier♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin O-senpai...
Flight-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm still just a fledgling hero,
but count on me!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO! Another new hero
has entered the sprint divisionnn!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A warm, enthusiastic welcome. And thus, Biko Pegasus was welcomed as the new star of the sprint division.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I finally see it.
The next hero that I'm striving to become!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to just be strong...
I want to be "a hero who can save someone"!
choice_data_list: Yeah, you managed to pull that off today!
Yeah, you totally pulled it off today!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, so next time, I want to run not for myself,
but for someone crying out for help!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, is there a rescue signal
coming from anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In dramas and movies, heroes are often
called upon for help. But I've never heard
of anything like that happening in a race.
choice_data_list: Do you remember anyone asking you for help?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Memories, huh... Oh, that reminds me...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
This is no time to be playing around out there!
Windy-chan is sick of being a laughingstock,
so do something about it~!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
(Windy-senpai was calling for help, wasn't she...
Saying she's been a laughingstock ever since
she tried to bite someone in that race.)

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: They just don't know. Windy-senpai might love pranks, but she has so many amazing qualities too!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Alright, to bring out that amazing side of hers,
I'll enter the same race as Windy-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is one major problem.
Shinko Windy is an Umamusume
whose main focus is dirt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Biko Pegasus has
always raced primarily on turf, but—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Sure, I've mostly been running on turf.
That doesn't mean I can't run on dirt, though.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: If it's for someone's sake, dive right in through sand or water! That's what a true hero does!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, which race do you think
Windy-senpai will enter next?
choice_data_list: Next up should be the G1 『February Stakes』...
Next up should be the G1 『February Stakes』, right...?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"The February Stakes! Got it!
I don't know if I can hold my own against fierce dirt competitors right off the bat, but...!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm not afraid!
Let's tackle dirt for our first Senior Class goal!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Phew, this is my first time doing such a big audition.
But...

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best! Even Biko-chan
is tackling it with everything she's got.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Having a small frame is definitely tough.
It's certainly a disadvantage. Even so...!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: I'll lay it all on the line and seize it too! This grand dream...!

text_block_list.name: Judge
text_block_list.text:
Next up, audition number 212,
please come forward!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sisters in spirit.
A challenge between two carrying the same handicap."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The action actor took on her audition,
and Biko Pegasus advanced to the
February Stakes.
